scope: US and Canadian import duty layers for China, Vietnam, Mexico and EU origins; outdoor gear, small electronics, apparel ch.61/62, kitchenware 9617/7323/7615/3924, bags 4202

layers.name: Normal (column 1 General) duty from the HTSUS
layers.legalAuthority: HTSUS 2026 edition; Revision 3 was the edition in force on 2026-02-19 (in force 2026-02-12 to 2026-02-25)
layers.scope: All origins. Column 1 Special rates apply for FTA/GSP claims (e.g. MX via USMCA 'S/S+').

layers.name: IEEPA synthetic-opioid ('fentanyl') duty on China and Hong Kong
layers.rate: +10% ad valorem on full customs value (was 20% from 2025-03-04 to 2025-11-09; 10% from 2025-02-04 under 9903.01.20).
layers.stacking: Stacks on MFN, Section 301 and Section 232 (EO 14289 non-stacking rule does not exempt it). Exceptions: 9903.01.21-.23 (donations, informational materials, old in-transit).
layers.scope: Products of China and Hong Kong (HTS heading text: 'product of China and Hong Kong').
layers.legalStatus: In force on 2026-02-19. Legality pending before the US Supreme Court in Learning Resources, Inc. v. Trump (No. 24-1287) consolidated with Trump v. V.O.S. Selections, Inc. (No. 25-250); argued 2025-11-05; no decision as of 2026-02-19.

layers.name: IEEPA reciprocal duty on China (34% country rate suspended; 10% applies)
layers.rate: +10% ad valorem on customs value.
layers.stacking: Not applied to Annex II goods (9903.01.32), Section 232 steel/aluminium/copper/auto/wood/semiconductor articles (9903.01.33), or the US-content portion where US content >= 20% (9903.01.34). For 232 derivatives where 232 is charged on metal content only, the non-metal content remains subject to the reciprocal duty.
layers.scope: Products of China, including Hong Kong and Macau.
layers.effectiveTo: Scheduled: EO 14358 suspends 9903.01.63 for one year from 10 Nov 2025; the 34% would then apply unless extended.
layers.legalStatus: In force on 2026-02-19. Legality pending before the US Supreme Court in Learning Resources, Inc. v. Trump (No. 24-1287) consolidated with Trump v. V.O.S. Selections, Inc. (No. 25-250); argued 2025-11-05; no decision as of 2026-02-19.

layers.name: IEEPA reciprocal duty on Vietnam
layers.legalAuthority: EO 14257 as modified by EO 14326 of 2025-07-31 (90 FR 37963)
layers.rate: +20% ad valorem on customs value.
layers.stacking: Same exclusions as other reciprocal headings (9903.01.30-.33 incl. Annex II and 232 goods; 9903.01.34 US content). Goods found transshipped to evade duties: 40% instead of the country rate (EO 14326 s.3), plus penalties.
layers.scope: Products of Vietnam.
layers.legalStatus: In force on 2026-02-19. Legality pending before the US Supreme Court in Learning Resources, Inc. v. Trump (No. 24-1287) consolidated with Trump v. V.O.S. Selections, Inc. (No. 25-250); argued 2025-11-05; no decision as of 2026-02-19.

layers.name: IEEPA reciprocal duty on the EU (15% all-in floor)
layers.legalAuthority: EO 14257 as modified by EO 14326 (90 FR 37963), Annex I
layers.rate: If column 1 General ad valorem (or AVE) rate < 15%: additional = 15% minus MFN, so MFN + reciprocal = 15%. If MFN >= 15%: reciprocal = 0.
layers.stacking: Excludes 9903.01.30-.33 (Annex II, 232 goods) and EU product carve-outs 9903.02.74-.78; 9903.01.34 US content rule applies.
layers.scope: Products of EU member states (e.g. Germany, Italy).
layers.legalStatus: In force on 2026-02-19. Legality pending before the US Supreme Court in Learning Resources, Inc. v. Trump (No. 24-1287) consolidated with Trump v. V.O.S. Selections, Inc. (No. 25-250); argued 2025-11-05; no decision as of 2026-02-19.

layers.name: IEEPA reciprocal baseline duty (countries without a specific rate)
layers.rate: +10% ad valorem.
layers.stacking: Excludes Canada (9903.01.26) and Mexico (9903.01.27) products, Annex II (9903.01.32), 232 goods (9903.01.33); US content >= 20% rule (9903.01.34).
layers.scope: Any country not listed in EO 14326 Annex I (and China, see US-IEEPA-RECIP-CN). Canada and Mexico are NOT subject to reciprocal duties.
layers.legalStatus: In force on 2026-02-19. Legality pending before the US Supreme Court in Learning Resources, Inc. v. Trump (No. 24-1287) consolidated with Trump v. V.O.S. Selections, Inc. (No. 25-250); argued 2025-11-05; no decision as of 2026-02-19.

layers.name: IEEPA border/drug duty on Mexico (non-USMCA goods)
layers.legalAuthority: EO 14194 (90 FR 9117), amended by EO 14227 (90 FR 11371) and EO 14232 (90 FR 11787, USMCA exemption)
layers.rate: +25% ad valorem on non-USMCA-qualifying goods; 0 for goods entered free under USMCA (General Note 11).
layers.stacking: Not applied to goods subject to 232 steel/aluminium/autos (EO 14289; HTS note 16(k), 19(h)). Mexico is not subject to reciprocal duties (9903.01.27).
layers.scope: Products of Mexico.
layers.legalStatus: In force on 2026-02-19. Legality pending before the US Supreme Court in Learning Resources, Inc. v. Trump (No. 24-1287) consolidated with Trump v. V.O.S. Selections, Inc. (No. 25-250); argued 2025-11-05; no decision as of 2026-02-19.

layers.name: IEEPA border/drug duty on Canada (non-USMCA goods)
layers.legalAuthority: EO 14193 (90 FR 9113), amended by EO 14231 (90 FR 11785) and raised to 35% by EO 14325 (90 FR 37957)
layers.rate: +35% ad valorem on non-USMCA-qualifying goods (25% before 2025-08-01).
layers.stacking: Not applied to 232 steel/aluminium/auto goods; Canada not subject to reciprocal duties (9903.01.26).
layers.scope: Products of Canada (relevant only if the brand re-imports Canadian-origin goods into the US).
layers.legalStatus: In force on 2026-02-19. Legality pending before the US Supreme Court in Learning Resources, Inc. v. Trump (No. 24-1287) consolidated with Trump v. V.O.S. Selections, Inc. (No. 25-250); argued 2025-11-05; no decision as of 2026-02-19.

layers.name: Legal status flag for all IEEPA layers
layers.legalAuthority: Learning Resources, Inc. v. Trump (No. 24-1287); Trump v. V.O.S. Selections, Inc. (No. 25-250)
layers.rate: n/a
layers.scope: All IEEPA layers above (China fentanyl, reciprocal, Mexico, Canada); and the IEEPA-based de minimis postal rates.

layers.name: Section 301 China duties, Lists 1, 2 and 3
layers.legalAuthority: Trade Act of 1974 s.301; USTR notices 83 FR 28710, 83 FR 40823, 83 FR 47974 (as modified)
layers.rate: +25% ad valorem.
layers.scope: Products of China in subheadings listed in HTS ch.99 subch. III note 20(b), (d), (f). Product set: 8504.40.70/.85/.95 (USB chargers, power supplies) List 3; 4202 bags (e.g. 4202.12.21/.81, 4202.22.15/.81, 4202.92.08/.31/.45/.91) List 3; 7323.99.90 List 3.
layers.exclusions: Product-specific exclusions under 9903.88.69 (note 20(vvv)), e.g. MMF textile backpacks 35-75 cm H x 19-34 cm W x 5-26 cm D (4202.92.3120) excluded from List 3 duty.
layers.exclusionsEffectiveTo: Scheduled: the 9903.88.69 exclusions were extended for one year from 10 Nov 2025.
layers.legalStatus: In force; not affected by the IEEPA litigation.

layers.name: Section 301 China duty, List 4A
layers.legalAuthority: Trade Act of 1974 s.301; USTR notice 84 FR 43304 (Aug 2019) as reduced by 85 FR 3741 (Jan 2020)
layers.rate: +7.5% ad valorem.
layers.scope: Products of China in note 20(s). Product set: 8512.10.20 and 8512.10.40 (bicycle lighting/signalling), 8518.21.00 and 8518.22.00 (loudspeakers incl. Bluetooth speakers), 6110.20.20 and most ch.61/62 apparel (e.g. 6109.10.00, 6110.30.30, 6205.20.20), 9617.00.40 (vacuum vessels > 2 L), 7323.94.00, 7615.10.30, 7615.10.91, 3924.10.20.
layers.notes: USTR FR citations for List 4A were not re-checked in this session; list membership was verified line by line in HTS 2026 Rev 3 note 20.

layers.name: Section 301 List 4B (suspended, no duty collected)
layers.legalAuthority: USTR List 4B (9903.88.16) suspended indefinitely (Dec 2019)
layers.rate: 0 (suspended).
layers.scope: Product set lines that are ONLY on List 4B, so pay no 301 duty: 9617.00.10, 9617.00.30, 9617.00.60 (vacuum flasks/tumblers <= 2 L and parts), 8513.10.20 and 8513.10.40 (torches/portable lamps), 7323.93.00 (stainless steel kitchen articles), 7323.99.30, 7615.10.71 (aluminium cookware, uncoated, not cast), 3924.10.40 (other plastic kitchenware).
layers.legalStatus: Suspended; HTS compiler's note retains the list.

layers.name: Section 301 four-year-review increase: lithium-ion batteries (non-EV) incl. power banks
layers.legalAuthority: USTR Notice of Modification, 89 FR 76581 (2024-09-18)
layers.rate: +25% ad valorem (replaces the former List 4A 7.5% on 8507.60.0020).
layers.scope: Products of China classified in 8507.60.00 (HTS note 31(g)); covers power banks with Li-ion cells classified in 8507.60.

layers.name: Section 232 steel and steel derivatives
layers.legalAuthority: Proclamation 10947 of 2025-06-03 (90 FR 24199), raising 25% to 50%; derivative inclusions by BIS, 90 FR 40326 (2025-08-19)
layers.rate: 50% ad valorem. For ch.73 goods (9903.81.89/.90/.93) and for 9903.81.91 goods, the duty is charged only on the declared value of the steel content; steel content weight reported in kg. UK: 25%.
layers.stacking: Excluded from IEEPA reciprocal (9903.01.33) for the steel content; non-steel content reported on a separate line and stays subject to reciprocal/IEEPA. Not subject to IEEPA Mexico/Canada duties (note 16(k)). China fentanyl duty and Section 301 still stack. FTA/GSP special rates do not relieve 232.
layers.scope: All countries (UK at 25%). Product set: 7323.10-7323.99 kitchen/household articles of steel (incl. 7323.93.00 stainless) ARE derivatives under 9903.81.90. Heading 9617 (vacuum tumblers) is NOT on any steel or aluminium derivative list.

layers.name: Section 232 aluminium and aluminium derivatives
layers.legalAuthority: Proclamation 10947 (90 FR 24199); BIS inclusions 90 FR 40326
layers.rate: 50% ad valorem; for ch.76 goods (9903.85.04/.07) and 9903.85.08 goods, charged on the value of the aluminium content only. UK: 25%.
layers.stacking: As for steel: aluminium content excluded from reciprocal (9903.01.33); not subject to IEEPA Mexico/Canada; China fentanyl and 301 still stack.
layers.scope: All countries (UK 25%). Product set: 7615.10.2015-.9100 aluminium kitchen/table articles are derivatives under 9903.85.07.

layers.name: Section 232 copper (semi-finished and intensive copper derivatives)
layers.legalAuthority: Proclamation 10962 (90 FR 37727)
layers.rate: 50% ad valorem.
layers.scope: Semi-finished copper and intensive copper derivatives; none in the product set.
layers.notes: Whether 50% is charged on copper content for derivatives was not re-verified in this session.

layers.name: Suspension of duty-free de minimis ($800) for all countries
layers.rate: No duty-free de minimis; all duties, taxes and fees apply regardless of value. Postal shipments: carrier pays either the IEEPA ad valorem rate for the origin country, or (for 6 months from 2025-08-29) a specific duty of $80 / $160 / $200 per item for country IEEPA rates <16% / 16-25% / >25%.
layers.scope: All countries, all modes.

layers.name: Merchandise Processing Fee, FY2026 (formal entries)
layers.rate: 0.3464% of customs value; minimum $33.58, maximum $651.50 per formal entry.
layers.scope: All formal entries (any origin); USMCA-originating goods are exempt from MPF.
layers.notes: USMCA MPF exemption stated from general knowledge; not re-verified in this session.

layers.name: Harbor Maintenance Fee
layers.rate: 0.125% of value; ocean (port use) shipments only, no cap.
layers.scope: Commercial cargo unloaded from vessels at covered US ports.
layers.notes: effectiveFrom is the long-standing rate date (not re-verified); rate verified in eCFR.

layers.name: USMCA preference for Mexican-origin goods
layers.legalAuthority: USMCA Implementation Act; HTSUS General Note 11; 19 CFR Part 182
chapter99: 9903.01.04 (exempts USMCA goods from Mexico IEEPA duty)
layers.rate: Column 1 Special 'S'/'S+' (generally Free) and no Mexico IEEPA 25%.
layers.scope: Goods that originate under USMCA rules of origin and are claimed at entry. Not a relief from Section 232 or 301.
layers.requirements: Importer must hold a certification of origin (any format, e.g. on the invoice) with the minimum data elements: certifier role; certifier, exporter, producer and importer name/address/contact; description and 6-digit HS of the good; origin criterion; blanket period (max 12 months); authorised signature and date. Certification may be completed by the importer, exporter or producer.
layers.notes: Data elements per CBP/CBSA summaries of USMCA Annex 5-A; regulation text 19 CFR 182.12 not opened line by line.

layers.name: Canadian Customs Tariff, January 1 2026 consolidation (T2026), MFN rates
layers.legalAuthority: Customs Tariff (S.C. 1997, c. 36); CBSA Customs Notice 25-31 (T2026)
layers.rate: Ad valorem on value for duty (VFD).
layers.scope: China gets MFN (no GPT). Vietnam gets MFN unless CPTPP origin is claimed.
layers.legalStatus: In force (T2026-1 and later amendments came after 2026-02-19).

layers.name: CUSMA Mexico Tariff (MXT)
layers.legalAuthority: Customs Tariff; CUSMA
layers.rate: Free for all sample tariff items listed above.
layers.scope: Goods originating in Mexico under CUSMA rules of origin, with a certification of origin (same minimum data elements as US).

layers.name: CETA EU Tariff (CEUT)
layers.legalAuthority: Customs Tariff; CETA
layers.rate: Free for all sample tariff items listed above.
layers.scope: Goods originating in the EU (e.g. Germany, Italy) under CETA rules, with an origin declaration.
layers.notes: Free rates verified in T2026; CETA in-force date from general knowledge.

layers.name: CPTPP Tariff (CPTPT) for Vietnam
layers.legalAuthority: Customs Tariff; CPTPP
layers.rate: Free for all sample tariff items listed above (e.g. 6110.20.00 Free vs MFN 18%).
layers.scope: Goods originating in Vietnam under CPTPP rules of origin (apparel: yarn-forward rules), with proof of origin.
layers.notes: Vietnam lost GPT eligibility on 2025-01-01 (CBSA CN 24-41), so CPTPT or MFN only. CPTPP in-force date for Canada-Vietnam from general knowledge.

layers.name: China Surtax Order (2024): electric vehicles
layers.legalAuthority: China Surtax Order (2024), SOR/2024-187, s.3 and Schedule 1
layers.rate: 100% of value for duty, on top of 6.1% MFN.
layers.scope: China-origin EVs; not in the product set.

layers.name: China Surtax Order (2024): steel and aluminium products
layers.legalAuthority: China Surtax Order (2024), SOR/2024-187, s.3.1 and Schedule 2, as amended by SOR/2024-202
layers.rate: 25% of value for duty.
layers.scope: China-origin goods. 7323, 7615, 9617, 8507 are NOT covered, so no surtax on the brand's Chinese kitchenware or batteries.

layers.name: Steel Goods and Aluminum Goods Surtax Order (China melted-and-poured / smelted-and-cast content)
layers.tariffItems: Part 1 steel goods 7206-7229, 7301-7306; Part 2 aluminium goods 7601, 7604-7609
layers.rate: 25% of value for duty.
layers.scope: Any origin except US-origin, if the goods contain steel melted and poured in China or aluminium smelted and cast in China. Exempt: declarations of $5,000 or less, casual goods, goods already under the China Surtax Order (2024). Not 7323/7615/9617.

layers.name: Surtax on over-quota steel goods (tariff rate quotas)
layers.legalAuthority: Order Imposing a Surtax on the Importation of Certain Steel Goods, SOR/2025-148; amended SOR/2025-155 (FTA partners from 2025-08-01) and SOR/2025-266 (quota cuts from 2025-12-26)
layers.tariffItems: Schedule 1: flat, long, pipe and tube, semi-finished and stainless primary steel products
layers.rate: 50% of value for duty on imports above country quota.
layers.scope: Non-FTA countries (from 2025-06-27) and FTA partners other than CUSMA (from 2025-08-01); US and Mexico excluded. Primary steel only; not the product set.
layers.notes: Quota levels and SOR/2025-155/-266 details from EY and Gazette remission order summaries.

layers.name: Steel Derivative Goods Surtax Order
layers.legalAuthority: SOR/2025-267; CBSA Customs Notice 25-33
layers.rate: 25% of value for duty.
layers.scope: All origins except Canadian-origin goods. Not stacked on goods already subject to the China Surtax Order (2024), US surtax orders, the steel TRQ surtax or SOR/2025-154. 7323, 7615 and 9617 are NOT listed; bike lights in 8512 are not 9405.

layers.name: Counter-tariffs on US-origin steel, aluminium and motor vehicles
layers.legalAuthority: United States Surtax Order (Steel and Aluminum 2025) [SOR number not verified]; United States Surtax Order (Motor Vehicles 2025), SOR/2025-118. United States Surtax Order (2025-1), SOR/2025-66, repealed 2025-09-01
layers.tariffItems: US-origin steel and aluminium products; non-CUSMA US vehicles
layers.rate: 25% of value for duty.
layers.scope: US-origin goods only; irrelevant for China, Vietnam, Mexico or EU origin. Non-steel/aluminium goods on the steel and aluminium list were relieved from 2025-09-01.
layers.legalStatus: Steel, aluminium and auto surtaxes in force; others removed 2025-09-01.
layers.notes: Steel/aluminium order effective date (2025-03-13) and SOR number not verified in this session; removal of other counter-tariffs on 2025-09-01 verified via Blakes and EY.

layers.name: Canadian 2025 counter-measures against China
layers.legalAuthority: None found
layers.rate: n/a
layers.scope: No new Canadian surtax specifically on Chinese-origin goods was found for 2025 beyond SOR/2025-154 (China-melted steel / smelted aluminium content, any origin).

layers.name: GST on imported goods
layers.legalAuthority: Excise Tax Act, Part IX, Division III (s.212, s.215); CBSA Memorandum D13-2-5
layers.rate: 5% of (value for duty + customs duties + other duties/surtaxes payable). Provincial sales tax is not collected by CBSA on commercial imports for resale (not verified for BC).
layers.scope: All commercial imports (GST registrants can claim input tax credits).
layers.notes: Base and 5% rate verified via CBSA; effectiveFrom is the date GST became 5% (general knowledge).

layers.name: Courier low-value shipment relief
layers.legalAuthority: Courier Imports Remission Order; CUSMA Art. 7.8(1)(f); CBSA Customs Notice 20-18
layers.rate: Any origin: duties and taxes waived if VFD <= CAD 20. US or Mexico origin (CUSMA) by courier: duties waived if VFD <= CAD 150; taxes waived if VFD <= CAD 40.
layers.scope: Matters only for parcel/B2C shipments; bulk commercial entries pay full duty and GST. Splitting shipments is not allowed.

lines.rate: n/a (heading 9617 not a listed steel derivative)

usSampleStacks.classification: 8512.10.20 'Lighting equipment' of a kind used on bicycles. Heading 8513 expressly excludes lighting equipment of heading 8512, so a battery bike light stays in 8512.10. Reflective/visual signalling only: 8512.10.40 (2.7%).
usSampleStacks.notes: If the light ships with a separately classifiable Li-ion battery, check 8507.60 (9903.91.06, 25%).

usSampleStacks.hts: 6110.20.20 (stat suffix by gender/type, e.g. .2010 men's sweaters, .2079 women's other)
usSampleStacks.notes: No Section 301 (China only). If CBP finds transshipment to evade duties, 40% replaces 20%. Same item from China would add 7.5% (List 4A) + 10% + 10%.

caSampleStacks.layers: MFN 7.5% + GST 5% on (VFD + duty). No China surtax, no steel derivative surtax.
CPTPT Free with CPTPP origin (else MFN 18%) + GST 5%. No GPT for Vietnam since 2025-01-01.
